notes: S2-FIX2 U5 (decision 2026-11-15 #22 by principle, as S2-FIX1 T2 for record signatures; §11.3): the manifest signatures are two ed25519 entries in key order: first an undeclared key ed25519:00…00, then human-1, whose value has one bit flipped. The human-1 entry is judged although the first entry's key is undeclared, and its failed equation is invalid: E_MANIFEST_SIG_INVALID, the pipeline stops at step (5).
